Enrich person.name: Lee Parr
Enrich person.title: Vice President - Accounting Manager in Accounting Operations
Enrich person.summary:
I serve as the Accounting Manager in the Accounting Operations group at BBVA USA.  
I support the month end close process and monthly accounting and analysis activities. This includes monitoring and assessing the various systems and reporting tools integral to the close process, posting journal entries, performing balance sheet reconciliations and ad hoc analysis to identify and resolve issues with financial impact.  

My responsibilities in Accounting Operations include several large reconcilements such the FED and Wire Clearing accounts via Frontier software, monitoring and reporting of Other Assets and Other Liabilities, REIT accounting, analysis of Intercompany Accounts and TEFRA backup withholding.  I provide reporting on a regular basis and manage internal and year-end external audit deliverables required from the department.  I address accounting related queries and resolve problems and issues promptly to deliver excellent customer service.  I pro-actively seek areas to improve the transactional accounting function and related internal processes.  I build the capabilities, tools, and skills within the general accounting team by driving high levels of individual accountability, engagement, empowerment and development, thus providing support for all direct reports to be successful in their roles.

I began my career with the Bank directly involved with the compliance and reporting of information to the FDIC related to assets covered by a loss share agreement. This included compilation of FDIC certificates, accounting for and management of the reporting of those loans, and maintaining policies and procedures related to the FDIC reporting process, ensuring that adequate controls existed and were in place to comply with the provisions of the loss share agreement. 

Before joining the BBVA USA team, I worked in public accounting where I served in both accounting and management capacities.

I am a graduate of the University of Alabama at Birmingham with a B. A. in Accounting and of the University of South Alabama with a B.A. in Finance.

I also assist in managing workflow by assigning cases, monitoring inventory levels for the team, and re-distributing when necessary. Outside the standard responsibilities, I provide tech support services, create / assign CLEAR templates, and assist with both new hire and continuing education training sessions. I appreciate that this role puts me in a position to mentor other team members, and I strive to lead by example.

experience.title: BSA/AML Investigator II
experience.summary:
As a member of the Law Enforcement Team I am responsible for investigating and decisioning a queue of high priority cases initiated via subpoena, 314A request, National Security Letter, executive referral, or other high priority channel. This position requires critical thinking, time management, and self-motivation. In this position I have worked cases involving high-level public corruption, international money laundering, large-scale investment fraud, drug-trafficking, human-trafficking, terrorist financing, and more. I am adept at untangling complex webs of financial activity, documenting my findings, and crafting narratives to explain the activity. In addition to my assigned tasks, I played a pivotal role in several technology and process improvements that saw average case times reduced by more than 30% (while continuing to exceed quality metrics). My contributions include, but are not limited to:
-	Creating, drafting procedures for, and training employees on a Case Notes file that helped centralize case information and reduce errors.
-	Drafting technology proposals for a new system to view check images in bulk (AIR), and for system upgrades to integrate Case Notes functionalities into the case management system. 
-	Providing training and support to all department staff for the new programs / procedures, and any other technology related issues.

experience.title: Corporate Security Case Management Analyst
experience.summary: I was the Case Management analyst assigned to work all referrals originating from Texas, Louisiana, Georgia, and South Carolina. In this position I was responsible for decisioning / processing check fraud claims and reviewing SAR Hotline referrals originating from my designated states. This position involved interpreting referrals, investigating and/or assigning said referrals, and following up on cases referred to Field Investigators to ensure timely submission. This position required strict compliance with regulatory reporting deadlines, communication with a broad range of internal / external partners, and continuous reprioritization of tasks. Case Managers worked with Field Investigators, Law Enforcement, and other financial institutions for reasons including initiating cases, providing research documentation, processing legal requests, and actively working to recover customer funds lost due to fraud. Case Managers were also responsible for answering “threat calls,” which involved someone reporting- in real time -threats of harm to Regions Bank or its employees. This experience taught me attention to detail, and how to remain calm in tense situations. In addition to my many functions as a Case Manager, I helped develop a Major Case reporting system and procedures, served on the SAR Star Award review panel, and processed all reconciliation payments for the bank.
